subject: Implementation milestones & buy-in — follow-up from 10/12 discovery
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Bennett <arielle@novushealth.com>, Devon Chu <devon.chu@novushealth.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: implementation milestones & next steps

Hi Arielle / Devon —

Thanks again for the time today — helpful to see the use cases and how latency/cost are gating a broader rollout. Quick recap of what we heard and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) in the attached Novus-MAP-v1.0.xlsx. Please confirm or edit.

Top pain points you shared:
- Unpredictable response times at peak (ED triage flows) causing clinician frustration
- Token cost scaling as prompt history grows; need a predictable unit cost per request
- Procurement and security review cycles are long and often block pilots

Business goals we aligned on:
- Proof-of-concept (POC) targeting 25k monthly queries with median latency < 350ms
- Validate retrieval+generation accuracy for discharge summary suggestions by Nov 2026
- Achieve a clear procurement path for production by Q1 2027

Proposed MAP (high level, draft attached):
1) Technical deep dive (engineers): week of 10/19 — 90 min (Redwood infra deep-dive + sample payloads)
2) Security evidence & questionnaire (Novus legal/security): target complete by 11/02 — we will provide SOC2, data retention, and network diagrams
3) Pilot setup & data prep: 11/15 start (4 weeks) — measure latency/cost and quality metrics
4) Exec review & procurement decision: by 12/15 — finalize SOW and pricing

Stakeholders we noted on the call (please confirm additions):
- Arielle Bennett — Clinical Product Lead (Novus)
- Devon Chu — Engineering Manager (Novus)
- Lisa Garner — Head of Procurement (Novus) — you mentioned Lisa may join the security thread
- Vanessa Ortiz — Solutions (Redwood)
- Mateo Alvarez — Customer Success (Redwood)

Attachments: Novus-MAP-v1.0.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW-template.pdf (standard document)

Questions / asks for you:
- Can you confirm Lisa Garner (procurement) and the legal contact for contract review?
- Are the target dates above reasonable for your team?
- Any additional technical stakeholders to include in the deep dive?

If that looks good I’ll lock the deep dive for 10/20 at 11am PT and send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Arielle Bennett <arielle@novushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Chu <devon.chu@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: implementation milestones & next steps

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few notes from our side:
- Confirmed: Lisa Garner (lisa.garner@novushealth.com) should be looped in for procurement and will own timelines from our side.
- Legal: our commercial counsel is Priya Shah (priya.shah@novushealth.com) — they’ll need the SOW and any data processing addendum.
- Security: we’ll need the SOC 2 report and a short summary of how you handle prefix/KV caching for PHI-like metadata (we discussed treating PHI as tokens to avoid retention).

Dates look fine — 10/20 deep dive works for our infra folks. I don’t expect additional technical stakeholders beyond Devon and our infra lead, Samir Patel (samir.patel@novushealth.com).

One ask on pricing: can you provide a ballpark estimate for the 4-week pilot (25k queries) ahead of the deep dive so procurement has a figure to budget?

Arielle
Clinical Product Lead | Novus Health
arielle@novushealth.com

Arielle / Vanessa —

Thanks — I’ll own the pilot onboarding from the CS side. A few practical notes:
- Pilot sizing: for 25k queries/month we typically recommend a small dedicated pool + autoscaling headroom; rough pilot estimate (compute + tokens) is $6k–$9k for the 4-week window depending on batching and prompt length. I’ll convert to a tighter number after the deep dive.
- Deliverable from us before 11/02: SOC2 snapshot, network diagram, and short runbook for the pilot (I’ll include a checklist in the MAP).
- Proposed pilot kickoff: 11/15 — we can shift earlier if your infra can prioritize.

Marissa — looping you in to help with the SOW and any procurement redlines once legal loops Priya in.

—Mateo
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: implementation milestones & next steps — agreed milestones + next steps

Arielle / Devon / Lisa (cc) —

Appreciate the quick confirmations. Based on the thread here’s an updated, actionable MAP (please reply with any edits by EOD 10/16):

Agreed milestones & owners:
- Technical deep dive (90m) — 10/20 11:00am PT — Owner: Vanessa (Redwood) + Devon, Samir (Novus)
- Security evidence handoff (SOC2, network diagram, caching notes) — target 10/23 — Owner: Mateo (Redwood)
- Pilot environment provisioning & data prep — start 11/15 — Owner: Novus infra + Redwood infra
- Pilot execution window (4 weeks) — 11/15–12/13 — Owner: Novus product + Redwood CS
- Executive review for procurement decision — week of 12/14, target sign-off by 12/17 — Owner: Arielle (Novus) + Marissa / Vanessa (Redwood)

Decision process (as discussed):
- Procurement requires a ballpark pilot cost for approval. Mateo provided a preliminary range ($6k–$9k). We will provide a refined pilot estimate after the technical deep dive by 10/23.
- Legal/Procurement will review the SOW and DPA concurrently during the pilot; procurement aims to complete review by exec review week (12/14).

Immediate next steps (actionable):
1) I’ll send calendar invite for 10/20 11:00am PT with agenda and pre-reads (Novus-MAP-v1.0.xlsx + pilot checklist).
2) Mateo to upload SOC2 snapshot and network diagram to the Drive link by 10/23.
3) Arielle to confirm Lisa Garner and Priya Shah are included on the procurement/legal thread.
4) Redwood to share a refined pilot cost estimate by 10/23.

If you confirm the stakeholder list and these dates we’ll treat the MAP as the working plan and I’ll move to lock resources on our side.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Vanessa Ortiz
